audit_scope: Worker-4 source-reviewed all linked DBAASP assay, experiment, and literature rows against paper XML/PDF, Table 1, supplement text, and local database snapshots; value matches are retained while database identity gaps are preserved as source_conflict.

conflict_adjudication_summary.dbaasp_peptide_name_gap: DBAASP assay rows are labelled SET-M33 while the paper assays SET-M33L and SET-M33L-PEG; the paper also relates M33 to SET-M33L, so the rows are useful but not clean sequence-verified database identity rows.
conflict_adjudication_summary.linked_sequence_snapshot_missing: linked_sequence_records.jsonl is empty for DBAASPS_15937; primary source sequence KKIRVRLSA and branched/PEG contexts were checked, but the local database snapshot cannot independently confirm sequence/modification fields.
conflict_adjudication_summary.assay_value_resolution: DBAASP MIC50/MIC90 values for P. aeruginosa and K. pneumoniae match the primary Table 1 aggregate summary rows and are kept as source-supported activity evidence.
conflict_adjudication_summary.supplement_resolution: Supplementary Tables S1 and S2 were text-indexed and checked as isolate-level support for the Table 1 distribution; they do not introduce a different database-linked aggregate value.
